definition.text: Whom Jehovah hides, or has made grow up. (1.) A Levite appointed to blow the trumpet before the ark of God (1 Chr. 15:24). (2.) Another Levite (Neh. 9:4, 5). (3.) A priest (Neh. 10:12). (4.) A Levite (Neh. 10:4).

lemmas.gloss: Shebanjah, the name of three or four Israelites
Sherebjah, the name of two Israelites
Hodijah, the name of three Israelites
Malluk, the name of five Israelites
Kadmiel, the name of three Israelites
Bani, the name of five Israelites
